title: Etale-origin comparison intertwines compact-support projection maps
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$ of characteristic $p$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$ of its valuation ring, and $n\geq1$. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix a compactification $c=(j,p_f)$, $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{p_f}Y$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements].
Use ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $V_T=\nu_T^*$ for exact derived comparison [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback], $F_f=Rp_{f,\mathrm{et},*}j^{\mathrm{et}}_!$ for ordinary etale compact support [def-amb-etale-compact-support], and $P_f=Rp_{f,\mathrm{proet},*}j^{\mathrm{proet}}_!$ [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. For a bounded-below etale complex $B$, let
$$C_B:P_fV_XB\xrightarrow{\sim}V_YF_fB$$
be the canonical comparison of [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison]. Let $M\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $H\in D^b_c(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes], and assume $H$ has finite Tor amplitude [def-kun-tor-amplitude]. Use ordinary derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor] and the corresponding pro-etale tensor [def-weil-derived-tensor]. Let $\operatorname{PF}^{e}_{M,H}:F_fM\otimes_A^LH\to F_f(M\otimes_A^Lf^*H)$ be the compactification composite of the proper counit-defined projection map [def-kun-projection-formula-map] and the canonical ordinary etale open-extension tensor comparison [lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor], and let $\operatorname{PF}^{p}$ be the pro-etale compactification projection map of [def-exchange-projection]. Then
$$C_{M\otimes_A^Lf^*H}\circ\operatorname{PF}^{p}_{V_XM,V_YH}
=V_Y(\operatorname{PF}^{e}_{M,H})\circ t_{F_fM,H}\circ(C_M\otimes1),$$
where $t_{B,H}:V_YB\otimes_A^LV_YH\xrightarrow{\sim}V_Y(B\otimes_A^LH)$ is the inverse of the canonical tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. On the left the target of $\operatorname{PF}^{p}$ is identified with $P_fV_X(M\otimes_A^Lf^*H)$ through [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback] and this same tensor comparison. The open part of $C$ uses the canonical site comparison [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison], extended termwise to complexes by exactness. The equality is natural in $M,H$ and uses the specified comparisons at the fixed compactification; it is an equality of derived morphisms. It asserts no smoothness or exceptional-pullback formula.

proof.text: The positive-level coefficient ring is finite. Bounded constructibility gives a cohomological interval for M, hence boundedness. Apply the proved source-library Etale.plus_derivedTensor_leftDerivedUpperStar after hasTorAmplitudeIn_iff_torAmplitudeIn: inverse image preserves the Tor interval and the derived tensor estimate gives boundedness, in particular the required bounded-below witness for M tensor Lf*H. No Tor hypothesis on M is used.

proof.text: Prove compatibility of the specified comparison pullback with composition. The underived support-site comparison coherence is transported through the exact derived-square pasting theorem, then conjugated by the canonical isomorphisms from left-derived pullback to the exact induced functor. Apply this natural-transformation equality to the compactification equation j followed by p equals f. Tensor naturality gives the corresponding identity for comparisonOpenTensorIso, keeping the entire isomorphisms intact before taking their hom components.

proof.text: Properness of the compactification factor gives the qcqs hypotheses. Normalize the inverse of the fixed compact-support comparison using the proved compactComparison_hom helper of CompactSupportExchangeTransport. Its proper factor is the right-derived comparison mate: proper_comparison_normalization identifies the D+ comparison with rightDerivedLowerStarComparisonIso prime, and sp_comparison_hom identifies the resulting ambient comparison with BoundaryComparison.directImageMate. Hence C inverse is this mate followed by proper image of the canonical open comparison. Expand both projection maps using their source-library compactification component formulas.

proof.text: Paste the proper and open squares using naturality of the direct-image mate at the etale open tensor arrow. Naturality of the pro-etale proper projection in its first input moves the proper image of the open comparison to the source. Functoriality and associativity identify its composite with the inverse compact-support comparison from Step 5. This proves compact_projection_square as an equality of the specified ambient derived morphisms.

proof.text: The target transport is the inverse of comparisonOpenTensorIso, by comparisonPullback_transport and the definitions. Precompose the square of Step 6 by the source tensor comparison and C_M tensor identity, postcompose by the inverse target comparison and C_D, and cancel the isomorphism pairs. This is precisely ProjectionComparisonEquation. Combine it with the bounded-below witnesses of Step 1 to prove the unchanged projectionComparisonConclusion. All identities are categorical naturality identities, including zero inputs, empty schemes and identity factors.

split_report.summary: Seven-step split with no new nodes. Checks bounded-below comparison domains using the Tor hypothesis on H alone, applies ringed-topos projection/exchange coherence to the proper part, verifies the open tensor square by restriction and full faithfulness, and pastes/cancels the specified comparisons. The statement and all statement dependencies are retained. No absolute separatedness assumption is added.

No change to the unit or chapter route.

tool_uses.why: Properness gives qcqs for the proper compactification factor; this is a generic geometric hypothesis check.
Generic lower Tor-bound K-flat model and pullback stability ensure the bounded-below comparison domains.
Generic exactness of ordinary etale extension gives the bounded-below inputs and degreewise comparison.
Generic lower Tor tensor estimate ensures both tensor inputs are in D+ without requiring Tor amplitude of M.
Generic ringed-topos tensor comparison fixes the tensor identifications on both sites.
Generic site pullback comparison fixes the comparison square and target identification.
Generic qcqs comparison supplies the specified counit mate, its naturality and invertibility.
Generic ringed-topos projection/exchange square supplies proper projection coherence for site comparison; the cohomological-smoothness unit has no replacement.
Generic canonical open site comparison supplies the open factor.
Generic pro-etale extension exactness permits the degreewise comparison on complexes.
Generic ordinary etale tensor identity fixes the open projection and its restriction.
Generic open-adjunction full faithfulness and normalization detect the open square after restriction; no smoothness is used.
Only its explicit formula for the canonical chosen-compactification site comparison is used; no composition or restriction result replaces a unit step.
Generic bounded-below compact-support site comparison is the specified C from the statement.
